known_defects.disposition: Deferred: no .gitattributes normalization is added in this binding because the commit scope is restricted to execution archives, checksum files, the execution binding and its verifier.
known_defects.impact: None on archive bytes, recorded digests, or any mathematical conclusion. A Windows working-tree checkout may render checksum text files with CRLF, which would make a naive local `sha256sum -c` of those text files disagree while the committed blobs remain correct.
known_defects.mitigation: All checksum text files in this evidence tree (SHA256SUMS and every <archive>.zip.sha256) were written with explicit LF bytes and committed as LF blobs; artifact ZIPs are binary and are byte-identical to the GitHub-produced archives.
known_defects.summary: The binding host is Windows with git core.autocrlf=true, which applies platform-default CRLF conversion to text files on checkout.

mathematical_effect.statement: Fifteen complete seven-point universal trims are directly checked 12-colorable, closing exactly those fifteen grandchildren. No parent, no q00r00, no q00 and no n11-k6-full status changes.
